ji.description: Inspect and address GitHub pull request feedback.

commands.name: exec-download-feedback
commands.description: Download current PR feedback as an LM-ready Markdown triage prompt.

commands.name: exec-map-branch-prs
commands.description: Map local branches to open PRs.

commands.name: exec-pr-details
commands.description: Return structured details for one GitHub PR.

commands.name: exec-branch-pr
commands.description: Return the open GitHub PR for a branch.

commands.name: exec-pr-reviews
commands.description: Return PR-level review bodies for one GitHub PR.

commands.name: exec-pr-review-threads
commands.description: Return hydrated review threads for one GitHub PR.

commands.name: exec-pr-discussion-comments
commands.description: Return PR discussion comments for one GitHub PR.

commands.name: exec-pr-checks
commands.description: Return normalized GitHub PR checks for one PR or the current branch PR.

commands.name: exec-reply-review-thread
commands.description: Reply to one GitHub PR review thread.
